description_expanded: Guests will enjoy this beautiful vacation home for the perfect getaway. Indulge in spa treatments, workouts, private training and other amenities at ZUMA wellness center situated just steps away. The home offers a relaxing & spacious great room with a view of the courtyard & fountain, a large dining table and fully equipped kitchen. A half bath and washer and dryer are also all on the main level. The 2nd floor bedroom has two single bunk beds and a private bath. The third floor primary suite with a king-sized bed and ensuite bath, offer a truly private feel. The third bedroom, with a king-sized bed and private bath, will be found across the courtyard in a carriage house arrangement also offering a covered patio and additional seating. Parking for this lovely home is found in a one-car garage and a designated parking space along North Castle Harbour Drive. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
